I went through both. Version B is what I'd want — when I change the address to a genuinely different page like the flexbox one, the title and description get gathered again to match that new page. That's the whole reason it fills details in automatically in the first place, so it'd feel wrong to keep "CSS grid layout" sitting on top of a flexbox page.

Version A keeping my old title and description just leaves the card describing the wrong thing.

The one thing I'd gently keep in mind: if I'd already hand-corrected the title and then only nudged the address a tiny bit — say trimming tracking junk off the end of the same page — re-gathering would basically pull the same details back anyway, so that's fine. My worry would only be if I'd carefully written my own title and it got wiped. But for the normal case of "I pointed it at a different page," gathering the details fresh is exactly right. Let's go with B.
